crossRefs.note: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”
Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you…
having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good…
Be careful, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn away to serve other gods and worship them;
For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn away from the way which I have commanded…
“Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you not turn…
Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be…
“They say, ‘If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him, and becomes another man’s, should he return to her…

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Samuel said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. You have indeed done all this evil; yet don’t turn away from following Yahweh, but serve Yahweh with all your heart.
translations.bsb: “Do not be afraid,” Samuel replied. “Even though you have committed all this evil, do not turn aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart.
translations.kjv: And Samuel said unto the people, Fear not: ye have done all this wickedness: yet turn not aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart;
translations.asv: And Samuel said unto the people, Fear not; ye have indeed done all this evil; yet turn not aside from following Jehovah, but serve Jehovah with all your heart:
